draft.subject: Re: Bulk import — and your first project
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks again for raising the bulk import question — your ticket is still open on our side and I'll follow up there with a clear answer rather than guess here. One thing I can confirm: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

In the meantime, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. Would a short call this week help? I'll walk through setting up your first real project for Blue Analytics with you.

Best,
Nadia
